title: Bolder hand for Investor Hub
question: A bolder hand, led by the Type Specimen. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Type Specimen
options.thesis: Progress is drawn in the type itself: the week's 312 thickens from hairline toward black as it closes on 500.
options.viewport: A giant weight-tracking 312 with a mono readout, a row of KPI numerals each weighted by its own progress, and follow-ups due beside it.
options.risk: Weight as data is subtle: every numeral also needs its plain figure and target beside it.

raised.raise: The vermilion accent appears only where something can be done: buttons, overdue rows, the check action.
Weights sit on a fixed ramp (0, 25, 50, 75, 100% of target) so numerals compare honestly across the page.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.thesis: The dashboard signs the next decision: a yellow band always says where today's work is and how much is waiting.
options.viewport: A yellow sign band as the top nav; a monumental '9' follow-ups due in a black inset; next-action band leading to the pipeline.
options.case: Strongest on product clarity: every screen points at the next job; less personal to the team.
options.risk: Yellow must stay reserved for navigation and next actions or it loses meaning.

options.label: Manual Tab Board
options.lineage: 1980s boxed-software manuals with coloured divider tabs
options.thesis: Each section owns a full-strength hue; a stepped tab rail down the right edge shows every section and how big it is.
options.viewport: Oxide-orange Overview board with white acetate panels for KPIs and follow-ups; the tab rail lists Check, Campaigns, Pipeline, Contacts, Staged.
options.case: Bold and very navigable; colour per section helps the team know where they are, but six hues is a lot to keep disciplined.
options.risk: Without strict rules, six section hues turn into a rainbow.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.lineage: boarding passes and live departure boards
options.thesis: Follow-ups rerank by due time like departures; a stage change stays lit until someone has seen it.
options.viewport: This week as a segmented pass (contacted, target, to go, days left); the follow-up board with one changed row held in the alert colour.
options.case: Clear for the daily follow-up job; the pass metaphor is decorative on the analytics pages.
options.risk: The pass shape can feel like a gimmick if it spreads beyond the weekly summary.

options.label: Warm Consumer App
options.thesis: Soft cards on a warm ground, one action colour.
options.viewport: A single column of cards with a bottom tab bar.
options.case: Too close to the category standard for a bolder round; bottom bar suits phones, not a laptop tool.
options.kept: The accent appears only where something can be done.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: The hashmap as a star field, engagement as magnitude.
options.viewport: A field of 21,486 dots with firms as constellations.
options.case: Beautiful for the hashmap, but tables and follow-ups lose clarity on a dark chart.
options.kept: Importance on a fixed size ramp.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean SaaS analytics dashboard (Linear / Stripe style), executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Left sidebar, KPI cards across the top, a chart and a follow-ups table.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from any other dashboard by design.
